title: Vibora White Shoulder Bag - Vibora
description:
WHITE VIBORA CROSSBODY BAG - High-end Vibora crossbody bag. For players who do not want a large padel bag or backpack, this is an excellent option to transport padel equipment comfortably and safely. The VIBORA WHITE CROSSBODY BAG is a perfect option for those looking for a comfortable, practical accessory with personality on and off the court. As it is a shoulder bag, it has an adjustable handle to be able to carry it comfortably. This product is an elegant replacement for a backpack or padel bag that normally takes up more space. It is the perfect complement for those of us who want better organization.

It has a large main compartment, designed to carry sports clothing, accessories or personal belongings in an orderly and accessible way. Its capacity is optimized to transport essentials without being uncomfortable or bulky.
